_doc: Medium batch m14 (Sonnet generic pass): family corrections only; colour/lift/snd left to the builder defaults.

thistle-beast/f:b1.note: thistle down is a drifting seed cloud: puff, avoids a second slash

thistle-beast/f:u3.note: a heaped pile of spines dropped down: bash, avoids a third thorn guard

nettle-lurker/f:b1.note: stench is a foul cloud: puff, avoids a second slash

nettle-lurker/f:u0.note: a curtain of stinging hairs hangs like strands: web, avoids three thorns

nettle-lurker/f:u1.note: wall of green stems: leaf (art beats thorns tag), Brush Sting keeps thorn

foxfire-wisp/f:b0.note: the stump glow is a green glow: sparkle, avoids a second slash

foxfire-wisp/f:b1.note: a puff of rotten glow: puff, name says puff

storm-wisp/f:b0.note: storm thread = lightning thread, crackling art: shock (not web)

storm-wisp/f:b1.note: drizzle cloud: puff (spore keyword would give leaf)

storm-wisp/f:u3.note: shed sparks: sparkle (art beats thorns tag), best guess
